search.title: Shannon Brown
search.snippet: Shannon Brown (born November 29, 1985) is an American former professional basketball player. He attended Proviso East High School in Maywood, Illinois

search.title: Sterling Brown (basketball)
search.snippet: Sterling Damarco Brown (born February 10, 1995) is an American professional basketball player for Žalgiris Kaunas of the Lithuanian Basketball League (LKL)
